LESSON: MY FAMILY CREATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: GOD’S
Topic 1.3: My family CREATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My family CREATION. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention that his/her family members are a gift from God.
2. appreciate God for creating his/her parents, brothers and sisters. pictures of family members displayed on charts, flash cards and watch relevant videos and films.(Luke 8:20). respond to God’s love by obeying their parents. (Ephesians 6:1-4)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention that his/her family members are a gift from God.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention that his/her family members are a gift from God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate God for creating his/her parents, brothers and sisters. pictures of family members displayed on charts, flash cards and watch relevant videos and films.(Luke 8:20). respond to God’s love by obeying their parents. (Ephesians 6:1-4)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate God for creating his/her parents, brothers and sisters. pictures of family members displayed on charts, flash cards and watch relevant videos and films.(Luke 8:20). respond to God’s love by obeying their parents. (Ephesians 6:1-4). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My family CREATION.
2. Explain My family CREATION to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand My family CREATION.
4. Show that you can: mention that his/her family members are a gift from God.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My family CREATION. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is My family CREATION important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention that his/her family members are a gift from God.
2. appreciate God for creating his/her parents, brothers and sisters. pictures of family members displayed on charts, flash cards and watch relevant videos and films.(Luke 8:20). respond to God’s love by obeying their parents. (Ephesians 6:1-4)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
